name: Skill Search
description: Search upstream skill repositories and install vetted skills with trusted-source provenance and community approval.

tools.name: skill_search
tools.title: Search Skills
tools.description: Search upstream skill repositories and return the best matching skill recommendation before hand-writing a workflow.
promptGuidelines: Use this before inventing a new recurring workflow skill; search results are metadata only and include source trust level.
Do not ask the user to choose from the candidate list. Read the candidates, select the best fit yourself, and use recommendedCandidate.candidateId when it is suitable.
If a suitable skill exists, call skill_install for the chosen candidate. Only the host approval shelf should ask the user to approve community installs.

query.description: Skill topic, workflow, product, or capability to search for.

tools.name: skill_preview
tools.title: Preview Skill
tools.description: Fetch and vet one skill candidate for body and risk inspection without installing it.
promptGuidelines: Preview does not install. Use skill_install to perform the enforced vetting, approval, and install path.

tools.name: skill_install
tools.title: Install Skill
tools.description: Fetch, vet, and install the selected upstream skill. Trusted sources install directly; community sources trigger host approval.
promptGuidelines: Prefer calling with a query when you know the needed capability; the tool will search, select the best matching candidate, vet it, and install it.
Call with a candidateId only when you have already selected the best candidate from skill_search results.
Do not ask the user to choose a skill or to approve in chat. Community approvals are handled by the host approval shelf.

candidateId.description: Candidate id returned by skill_search after the agent selected the best fit.

query.description: Capability or workflow needed; the tool searches and installs the best matching skill.

limit.description: Maximum search results to consider when query is provided, capped at 20.

settingsComponent.label: Skill Search
settingsComponent.description: Upstream skill search, vetting, and installed skill provenance.
